intro: A clear and straightforward process from your first message to the completed repair, with assessment, quotation and handover at every stage.

steps.title: Tell Us the Vehicle and Symptoms
steps.text: Start with the registration, model/year, mileage, location and whether the engine runs. Include any existing diagnosis, photographs or engine details.
steps.fullText: Start with the registration, model/year, mileage, location and whether the engine runs. Include any existing diagnosis, photographs or engine details. If the vehicle should not be driven, discuss arrival or recovery before moving it.

steps.title: Establish the Engine and Agree the Assessment
steps.text: We identify the likely engine route and discuss the checks needed. Inspection and, where necessary, agreed dismantling establish the condition and the work that can be quoted.
steps.fullText: We identify the likely engine route and discuss the checks needed. The initial guide is not a remote diagnosis. Inspection and, where necessary, agreed dismantling establish the condition and the work that can be quoted.

steps.title: Approve the Scope, Then Arrange Work and Handover
steps.text: The quotation explains the proposed repair, included work and separate items. Changes revealed during strip-down are discussed before extra work proceeds. After completion, handover covers the repair and next service.
steps.fullText: The quotation explains the proposed repair, included work and separate items. Changes revealed during strip-down are discussed before extra work proceeds. After completion, handover covers the repair, maintenance and required follow-up service.
